test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train takes 1 hour and 12 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 90 km/h. If the speed is increased by 40%, then how long will it take to cover (7)/(3) of the distance?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 90 km/h

Time = 1 hour and 12 minutes

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

1 hour 12 minutes = 1.2 hours [12/60 = 0.2]

So, distance = 1.2 × 90

⇒ 108 km

Now,

7/3 of the distance = 252 km

New speed = 90 × 7/5 = 126 km/h

Time = 252/126 = 2 hours

**∴ Required time is 2 hours**
